label: Spotlight · Executive BD · Singapore
title: An executive food tour, paid in PYUSD
text: For executives in town for Token2049 and Breakpoint, we built a working payment flow with Solana Pay and Venta, then took them on a food tour: a hawker stall, cocktails and a BBQ. Every guest was airdropped PYUSD to pay and tip the vendors along the way.

steps.title: Airdrop
steps.text: Guests arrive with PYUSD sent to their wallet on Solana.

steps.title: Tap to pay
steps.text: At each stop they pay with a Solana Pay code on a Venta terminal.

steps.title: Tip the vendors
steps.text: Tips go straight to the vendors in PYUSD, paid out in crypto or local currency, their choice.
